status: EXPLORATORY (outside the amend5 decision rule, which FAILED for every rule). Results are reported as exploratory; conf is the only unbiased test.
post_hoc_disclosure: The disagree gate (xiou(k_sggl) < 0.5) was chosen AFTER looking at dev OR0F: R_piou's offline gain sits entirely in disagree switches (VOST n=270 prec 0.61 dJ_sum +66; LVOS n=165 prec 0.85 +111; MOSEv2 n=235 prec 0.24 -10). Proposed by the independent Fable agent, reproduced exactly on Ubuntu.

definitions.switch (GT-free): on frames with a non-empty SGGL output: k_sg = SAM 2's pick in the output view (argmax predicted IoU there); pick = argmax predicted IoU over all 6 raw hypotheses; switch iff pick != k_sg, piou(pick) > piou(k_sg) and IoU(k_sg mask, other view's mask) < 0.5
definitions.VXO: output switched to pick; memory native (the L crop centre follows the output, so this is already an online test)
definitions.VXM: VXO + the OUTPUT view's frame-t memory re-encoded from the picked (other-view) hypothesis via the SAM 2 mask-input path
definitions.N1M: SGGL output; at exactly VXM's switch frames on that unit, the output view's memory re-encoded from its OWN native mask (path effect of the write itself)
definitions.N2X: same NUMBER of switches as VXM per unit at seeded random frames (skipped when the output is empty): output = a random hypothesis of the other view, and the output view's memory re-encoded from it

criteria_dev: VER = VXO and VXM separately. (1) VER - OR0 video-bootstrap CI lower > 0 on VOST; (2) MOSEv2 point estimate >= -0.005 (non-harm; offline says null there); (3) VXM > N1M and VXM > N2X point estimates on VOST and MOSEv2; (4) units below -0.05 for VER <= N2X's count. LVOS reported (not gating: few videos). Winner: VXM if it passes and beats VXO by > 0.005 on both VOST and MOSEv2, else VXO if it passes.
conf: the winner (and N2X) run once on MOSEV2:conf, VOST:conf vs OR0 on conf (run on this pod); same criteria (1),(2),(4). Fail -> 'dev only'.
